title: Canonical left-translation coaction on an actual regular-function subspace
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $G,L$ be $F$-group schemes with $L$ affine and $i:L\to G$ a homomorphism [def-sc-group-scheme], and let $W\subseteq F[G]$ be an $F$-linear subspace [def-sfb-rho-section-module-data]. Use the actual coordinate algebras, scalar structures and evaluation maps of [def-sfb-rho-section-module-data], and the actual tensor products of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. A linear map $c:W\to W\otimes_F F[L]$ is the canonical left-translation coaction if, for every commutative $F$-algebra $A$, every $s\in L(A)$, $g\in G(A)$ and $f\in W$, the image of $c(f)$ under $W\otimes F[L]\to F[G]\otimes F[L]\to A$, with the last map $a\otimes b\mapsto\operatorname{ev}_g(a)\operatorname{ev}_s(b)$, equals $\operatorname{ev}_{i(s)^{-1}g}(f)$. This identity on every algebra uniquely specifies the rational action; the identity and multiplication laws of $L$ give its counit and coassociativity laws. No dimension restriction on $W$ or reducedness restriction on $A$ is imposed.
